name: patient_has_finding_of_abdominal_pain_characteristic_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has characteristic abdominal pain.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has characteristic abdominal pain.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have characteristic abdominal pain.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has characteristic abdominal pain.

name: patient_serum_lipase_measurement_value_recorded_now_withunit_u_per_l
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current serum lipase measurement in units per liter (U/L).
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if a serum lipase measurement in U/L is available for the patient now.

name: patient_amylase_measurement_serum_value_recorded_now_withunit_u_per_l
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current serum amylase measurement in units per liter (U/L).
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if a serum amylase measurement in U/L is available for the patient now.

name: patient_has_undergone_imaging_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has undergone imaging now.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone imaging now.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not undergone imaging now.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone imaging now.

name: patient_serum_lipase_upper_limit_of_normal_value_now_withunit_u_per_l
meaning: Numeric value representing the upper limit of normal for serum lipase (U/L) for the patient now.
when_unknown: Set to null if the upper limit of normal is not available or indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the reference upper limit of normal for serum lipase (U/L) for the patient now, as per laboratory standards.

name: patient_serum_amylase_upper_limit_of_normal_value_now_withunit_u_per_l
meaning: Numeric value representing the upper limit of normal for serum amylase (U/L) for the patient now.
when_unknown: Set to null if the upper limit of normal is not available or indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the reference upper limit of normal for serum amylase (U/L) for the patient now, as per laboratory standards.

name: patient_has_elevation_in_serum_lipase_to_three_times_or_greater_than_upper_limit_of_normal_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's serum lipase is at least three times the upper limit of normal now.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's serum lipase measurement is at least three times the upper limit of normal now.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's serum lipase measurement is less than three times the upper limit of normal now.
when_unknown: Set to null if either the measurement or the upper limit of normal is unavailable or indeterminate.

name: patient_has_elevation_in_serum_amylase_to_three_times_or_greater_than_upper_limit_of_normal_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's serum amylase is at least three times the upper limit of normal now.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's serum amylase measurement is at least three times the upper limit of normal now.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's serum amylase measurement is less than three times the upper limit of normal now.
when_unknown: Set to null if either the measurement or the upper limit of normal is unavailable or indeterminate.

name: patient_meets_biochemical_criteria_for_acute_pancreatitis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient meets the biochemical criteria for acute pancreatitis now (lipase or amylase ≥3x ULN).
when_true: Set to true if the patient has either serum lipase or serum amylase elevated to at least three times the upper limit of normal now.
when_false: Set to false if neither is elevated to at least three times the upper limit of normal now.
when_unknown: Set to null if the relevant measurements or upper limits are unavailable or indeterminate.

name: patient_meets_clinical_criteria_for_acute_pancreatitis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient meets both characteristic abdominal pain AND biochemical criteria for acute pancreatitis now.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has characteristic abdominal pain AND meets the biochemical criteria for acute pancreatitis now.
when_false: Set to false if either characteristic abdominal pain or biochemical criteria is not met now.
when_unknown: Set to null if either component is unavailable or indeterminate.

name: patient_has_finding_of_fit_and_well_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently classified as healthy (fit and well).
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently classified as healthy (fit and well).
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not classified as healthy (fit and well).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently classified as healthy (fit and well).

name: patient_has_finding_of_fit_and_well_now@@classified_based_on_research_by_primary_care_clinicians_control_group
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's healthy (fit and well) classification is based on research conducted by clinicians of primary medical care (control group).
when_true: Set to true if the patient's classification as healthy (fit and well) is based on research conducted by clinicians of primary medical care (control group).
when_false: Set to false if the patient's classification as healthy (fit and well) is not based on research conducted by clinicians of primary medical care (control group).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the classification as healthy (fit and well) is based on research conducted by clinicians of primary medical care (control group).
